about: Broadcast-style scorebugs. Each is drawn from scratch after a real broadcast's look; no network logos or wordmarks are drawn. The bug files are bugs/<id>.js. networks: the networks (plain names) that show this look today, used when a widget picks bug: network; leagues: the leagues it is matched to for that. A bug with tv is drawn with that old-TV picture by default (soft = standard-definition blur and scanlines, vhs = also colour bleed); the widget's bug_tv option overrides it. dresses: the playoff looks a bug has (playoffs, conf-finals, finals); it switches by itself from the game's season and round, or the widget's bug_dress picks one. postseason: a tournament's own look, matched to a network only for postseason games. event_logos: tournaments' own logos, loaded at display time from Wikimedia (nothing stored), matched on ESPN's event name per sport.
